end.summary:
Practised making 100 using tens and number-line jumps.
Counted 30 to 100 in seven jumps of 10.
Found 80 needs 20 to make 100 and explained two jumps of 10.
For 65, mixed up digit-wise pairing with finding the total partner; 75 + 35 = 110 was noticed as over 100.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised making 100 with tens numbers and using jumps on a number line. Vihaan explained that 80 needs 20 and counted two jumps of 10 from 80 to 100. They mixed up matching digits to 10 with finding the number that completes 100; this was still present at the last example. At home, use pairs such as 60 + 40 and 65 + 35, checking each answer by counting up to 100.
